_note: Dated non-earnings catalysts (OUTSIDE). Earnings, ex-dividend and IPO lockup dates come from the day files; this file holds what they cannot see: macro releases, central banks, index reviews, regulatory decisions, conferences. One row per event: date (YYYY-MM-DD, the session it lands in), kind (macro / central_bank / policy / index / regulatory / conference / commodity / market), event, status (confirmed / estimated / disputed), source (where the date was read, with the read date), optional symbols (EXCHANGE:TICKER the event is about) and read (what it moves). Append, do not rewrite; mark a moved date 'disputed' with both sources. Timing and Grade only: never a sort key or a size. Optional per row for tv_scan_cli.py event-risk: exposure {down|up|either: [themes.json names]} (which crowds the event moves, OUTSIDE judgment with its source in read), binary: true (a two-sided event even outside kind policy), odds_kind (the sentiment_outside.json kind that holds its odds). A policy row with no symbols counts as a market-wide binary event (the P letter on every line it does not map).
